# Silvaneo Vieira dos Santos Junior

<p class="hero-institution">The University of Texas at Austin · Austin, TX</p>

<p class="hero-summary">
My research focuses on Bayesian time series, state-space models, longitudinal data,
and causal inference. I work on sequential inference for dynamic generalized linear
models, simulation-free Bayesian methods, longitudinal surrogate evaluation, and
time-series mixture models.
</p>

## Current research

<div class="cards">

<div class="card">
### Longitudinal surrogate evaluation

A state-space framework for causal evaluation of jointly longitudinal outcomes
and surrogate markers, with accompanying software in the **OnlineSurr** R package.

[Preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12882) ·
[OnlineSurr](https://github.com/silvaneojunior/OnlineSurr)
</div>

<div class="card">
### Sequential Bayesian dynamic models

Sequential inference for dynamic generalized linear models, including
simulation-free Bayesian analysis and information-geometric methods implemented
in **kDGLM**.

[kDGLM](https://github.com/silvaneojunior/kDGLM) ·
[Preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.05387)
</div>

<div class="card">
### Time-series mixture models

Ongoing work on sequential methods for mixture models in time-series settings.
</div>

</div>
